messages:
emily: quick heads-up 1 — onboarding smoke for shiori-v3 int6 flagged a locale-sensitive regression on the mixed-orient suite (JP/ZH with ruby + AR snippets). BLEU delta ~ -8.5 vs fp16.

raj: ugh. paste the eval summary + a failing example pls.

emily: pasted eval-bot output below (suite mixed-orient-2026-03).

eval-bot: MODEL=shiori-v3-int6 | TASK=mixed-orient-translate | QUANT=int6 | BLEU=23.6 (int6) vs 32.1 (fp16) | avg_tokens/sent int6=16.7 fp16=12.5 | fail_rate=0.09
example_input: "60_例:?? 5d50(
3) said: 633644627645"
fp16_output: "5d50(0429) said: 633644627645"
int6_output: "5d50 said: 633644627645"  (ruby reading lost; parentheses repositioned)

minji: token counts differ — that's usually a tokenizer/fallback normalization issue.
sven: ran a quick tokenizer probe locally:
```
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
T = Tokenizer('shiori')
s = '\u5d50(\u3042\u3089\u3057) said: \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645'
print('fp16 len', len(T.encode(s, mode='fp16')))
print('int6 len', len(T.encode(s, mode='int6')))
```
-> fp16 len: 12
-> int6 len: 19

raj: q4/q8 behave?
emily: q4 and fp16 are close to baseline; regression reproducible only on int6 runtime.

minji: suspects: 1) int6 preproc normalization table or branching for high-plane codepoints, 2) fallback tokenization in the int6 kernel, 3) detok glue/orientation handling differs for the int6 detok path.
sven: can you dump token ids for the failing example from both runs and diff them? that'll show split boundaries.
emily: uploaded token-id diffs + minimal repro to internal gist, linked in ticket. summary: int6 splits ruby kana into single-char tokens and fragments the Arabic run; token_count jumps and detok loses the ruby chunk.

raj: i'll start a kernel bisect across the int6 runtime commits (range b2f..c9a) and run tokenizer-only units to find first bad commit.

minji: i'll add a deterministic detok+tokenizer roundtrip smoke for mixed-orient samples to the onboarding CI to catch bracket/orientation regressions early.

emily: action items: 1) raj - bisect int6 kernels & post earliest bad commit + repro; 2) sven - attach token-id diffs and minimal repro; 3) minji - add detok/tokenizer smoke to CI. Mark model onboarding P0 and hold int6 rollout until root cause known.

eval-bot: created ticket ML-1402 with failing examples and CI artifacts: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1402

raj: starting bisect now, will update with suspect commit or repro script in ~90m.
emily: thanks team :thumbsup:
